svg.text: One neural network shared by every agent · PPO actor-critic · 414,542 weights in total
convolution layers: small 3×3 pattern detectors slide over the view
turns the body numbers into feelings like "very thirsty"
combines what it sees with how it feels
set negatives to 0. It lets the
example: thirsty agent next to a river
every tick, each living agent feeds its own VIEW and SELF through this same network, then picks an action at random using the ACTOR's chances.
after each round, actions that turned out better than the CRITIC expected become more likely, worse ones less likely (PPO), and the CRITIC's guesses are corrected.
